name: Milestone Furniture Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2014, Milestone Furniture Ltd manufactures home and office furniture and also does home and office designing[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company deals in Modular Furniture, Chairs, Retail, School & Educational Institute Furniture. It has a separate business unit for Turnkey Projects in commercial and residential sectors. Company designs, builds, operates, and maintains projects all over India and specific regions of Asia

pros: Stock is trading at 1.00 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -2.33% over last 3 years.
